Summary: DeepSeek-V3.1 is a 685-billion-parameter model, as stated in one source, but other sources indicate it has 671 billion parameters. The model features a 128,000-token context window and supports multiple tensor formats for efficient performance. It is based on the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture, activating only 37 billion parameters per token. The model has a hybrid design integrating reasoning and non-reasoning functions into a single model and supports native tool use, search, and coding.
